id: \bWhat a skilled trainer you are. This gym is as good as yours.
en: \bWhat a skilled trainer you are. This gym is as good as yours.
it: \bChe Allenatore abile sei. Questa Palestra è praticamente tua.

id: \bGrant: Good job kid. You've climbed all the way up here without any help. I can't ignore that kind of will. Let's go all out!
en: \bGrant: Good job kid. You've climbed all the way up here without any help. I can't ignore that kind of will.  Let's go all out!
it: \bLino: Ottimo lavoro, ragazzo. Sei salito fin quassù senza alcun aiuto. Non posso ignorare una tale forza di volontà. Diamoci dentro!

id: \bAnd don't worry. In this gym you can use as many Pokémon as you want. Don't hold back.
en: \bAnd don't worry. In this gym you can use as many Pokémon as you want. Don't hold back.
it: \bE non preoccuparti. In questa Palestra puoi usare tutti i Pokémon che vuoi. Non trattenerti.

id: \bTM118 contains Rollout. It gets stronger with each hit.
en: \bTM118 contains Rollout. It gets stronger with each hit.
it: \bL'MT118 contiene Rotolamento. Diventa più forte a ogni colpo.

id: \bGrant: Head north of here. A gym should be there for you to challenge.
en: \bGrant: Head north of here. A gym should be there for you to challenge.
it: \bLino: Dirigiti a nord da qui. Lì dovrebbe esserci una Palestra da sfidare.

id: \bGrant uses Rock type Pokémon. They are weak aganst Water, Grass, Fighting, Ground, and Steel types.
en: \bGrant uses Rock type Pokémon. They are weak aganst Water, Grass, Fighting, Ground, and Steel types.
it: \bLino usa Pokémon di tipo Roccia. Sono deboli contro i tipi Acqua, Erba, Lotta, Terra e Acciaio.

id: \bDespite all the weaknesses, they are strong against Fire, Bug, Flying, and Ice. Normal and Poison moves also don't do much damage.
en: \bDespite all the weaknesses, they are strong against Fire, Bug, Flying, and Ice. Normal and Poison moves also don't do much damage.
it: \bNonostante tutte queste debolezze, sono forti contro Fuoco, Coleottero, Volante e Ghiaccio. Anche le mosse di tipo Normale e Veleno non fanno molti danni.

id: \bHow did you climb up here already?
en: \bHow did you climb up here already?
it: \bCome hai fatto ad arrampicarti fin quassù così in fretta?

id: \bGrant may seem tough, but he has a soft spot for those that work non stop.
en: \bGrant may seem tough, but he has a soft spot for those that work non stop.
it: \bLino può sembrare duro, ma ha un debole per chi si impegna senza sosta.
